build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 93% (4), magic_wand 58% (10), phase_boots 95% (10), headdress 53% (15), ancient_janggo 52% (18), blitz_knuckles 58% (19), claymore 57% (22), great_famango 24% (23), invis_sword 55% (24), staff_of_wizardry 46% (25), ogre_axe 36% (27), blade_of_alacrity 29% (28). Reviewed: dropped Headdress (53%), Blitz Knuckles and Claymore (parts of Shadow Blade), Staff of Wizardry, Ogre Axe and Blade of Alacrity (parts). STRATZ pos4 (12880 games) agrees on Drum of Endurance 15 min (38%) and Shadow Blade 23 min (95%) and adds Eul's Scepter 28 (25%) and Yasha and Kaya 32 (22%), which the league games do not show (Eul's under 25%).
